verdicts.reason: A has no clear hierarchy. The three badges are almost as big as the CTA, the legal text is as large as the body copy, and the CTA pill runs off the bottom edge with the missing-asset box clipped beneath it. The headline is jammed into the top-right corner and the tilted SUNSET SALE badge floats over the middle. B is better: the large left-aligned headline leads, the CTA is clear, and the copy is grouped on the right. B still fails, though. The product can is shrunk to a tiny icon, and the badges and SUNSET SALE are crammed into one uneven row along the top. The body copy is small, the missing-asset placeholder still shows, and the headline sits close to the bottom edge.
